messages:
maria gonzalez: heads-up — rolled egress/IAM tighten to az-1 at 02:14 UTC, seeing ~40% of GPU warmpool nodes fail to join. keystore logs show kms:Decrypt denied. Should we rollback now?
raj patel: on it. can you paste the error snippet and the change-id?
maria gonzalez: change-id: ch_0a9f, snippet: 
```
2026-03-23T02:16:10Z ERROR keystore decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/node-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234
```
sasha li: looks like the new iam condition requiring aws:SourceVpcArn is blocking privatelink-bound nodes. az-1 warmers use privatelink endpoint ep-0c1f, are we sure that was included in the rollout?
tyler cho: also seeing audit-exporter queuing and cloudwatch spikes — if autoscaler keeps retrying we could get huge spot churn costs. rough cost risk: +$2-5k if it runs uncontrolled for a few hours.
policy-watch-bot: policy-change-detected ch_0a9f by maria.gonzalez — rules: deny kms:Decrypt unless SourceVpcArn in [vpc-aaa, vpc-bbb].
maria gonzalez: thanks. i'm going to propose a temporary allow for node-role from affected subnet so nodes can join, then we fix the condition to include privatelink endpoint id. anyone object to rollback patch? :thinking_face:
raj patel: agree with temporary allow. rollback patch + audit trail. can we scope it to subnet-az1 and add expiration 3h?
sasha li: yes i'll prepare a small PR to expand the condition to include the privatelink endpoint (ep-0c1f) and a unit test for the keystore integration. will test in staging immediately.
maria gonzalez: executing rollback now: `./infra iam apply --patch allow-node-role-kms-decrypt --scope subnet-az1 --expires 2026-03-23T05:00:00Z`
policy-watch-bot: rollback executed ch_0a9f-rollback by maria.gonzalez at 02:41 UTC. audit-log: https://logs.internal/replay/ch_0a9f-rollback
tyler cho: nodes are trickling back into the warm pool, from 60% failure -> ~5% fail. monitoring up. pausing autoscaler temporary to avoid churn.
maria gonzalez: great. action items: 1) sasha: PR to update condition + test (link please), 2) raj: follow-up deploy with canary & audit retention, 3) ops: keep billing alert on. i'll open a short incident ticket and assign owners.
sasha li: PR opened #repo/infra/pulls/342 — includes extra condition for ep-0c1f + rollback-proof gating. staging tests pass.
raj patel: i'll schedule a controlled rollout to az-1 tomorrow 03:00 UTC with expanded conditions and a 15m canary.
maria gonzalez: closing loop here — rollback stabilized things. we'll document in postmortem (inc-1717932468). thanks all :thumbsup:
